board: S1.1b · First run → Browse templates, Templates drawer open (Figma 807:4299)
_note: Board 807:4299 — first run, Templates drawer opened from the canvas CTA.
Measured LIVE: the whole point of the frame is that one press of `Browse
templates` on an empty canvas puts the drawer on screen, and a probe that
mounted the drawer would skip the press. The press is a real step here and
it works.
A SMALL RECIPE, and the reason is the finding rather than an excuse: almost
every element this board draws is already settled by a board that owns it
better, and this frame agrees with none of them. Named one by one so nobody
re-opens them:
· The CTA's two BUTTONS. 807:4326 draws `Browse templates` 34 tall, 14
across, on --radius/sm 4 with a 13px label; 807:4328 draws `Start blank`
the same with a --color/border-input #9CA3AF rule. The code cites board
338:2326 — a real Button COMPONENT instance — for 32 / 16 / radius 8 /
14px, and records that 297:2013 (the sibling `Start blank` frame) is
hand-drawn, 'not a component instance', disagreeing with its own
neighbour on every shared property. 807:4326/4328 are a third and fourth
hand-drawn frame in that argument. A component board beats a screen
frame; both buttons are anchored and SKIPPED.
· The action row's GAP. 807:4325 says 10, so does 65:203, and the code
says 12 with its reason at the call site: there is no 10 on the 4px base
scale DESIGN.md mandates and no token for it. That is a design-system
argument, not a board one, and two boards drawing an off-scale value do
not make it on-scale.
· The DRAWER frame. 807:6534 is 280 x 812 with a --flowbite/gray/100 rule.
Live it is 780 tall (this shell has a page-tab bar the board does not
draw) and its right-hand rule lives on `.layout-shell__drawer`, not on
the panel — so a `border-color` read off the panel returns #111827, the
initial value, which is the same trap the Media panel hit. Shell
geometry, shell boards.
· The CANVAS ground. 807:4321 draws --flowbite/gray/50 with 32 of bottom
padding; the shell paints --color/bg-app gray-100 with 20. Another
shell-wide fact on a Templates board.
· The template CARDS (807:6540/6544/6548 — 248x100, bordered, radius 8,
over a 56-tall thumb, 12px title). The gallery's own board is 641:2487,
which the code cites for a full-width 88-tall thumb and a 13/20 title,
and `templates-empty` measures that family against 1138:13413. Two
boards, one card: neither re-settles it.
WHAT IS LEFT IS GENUINELY THIS BOARD'S: the empty-canvas CTA block itself —
807:4323's 12 gap and 807:4324's 16/24 ink headline — measured in the state
this frame is about, with the Templates drawer open beside it.
TWO BOARD-LEVEL BLOCKERS, neither settleable from code:
· PLACEMENT. This frame draws the Templates drawer at x=1120, to the RIGHT
of the canvas, where DESIGN.md:231 puts every drawer at x=60. LEDGER
2026-09-02 lists it as designer-redraw D2 ('canvas must move with it')
and BLOCKERS C7. Measured where the product puts it; x is not compared.
· EXISTENCE. The same entry records a live contradiction about whether
this surface should exist: DESIGN.md:286 and 14-screen-specs.md:174 say
Templates was 'dissolved into the New-Page flow + Insert',
12-feature-catalog.md:77 ships it, 12:177 leaves 'F2 collapse still
open'. Owner: founder.
FOR THE NEXT AGENT WHO MEASURES ANY TEMPLATES ANCHOR HERE: every `tpl-*`
testId resolves TWICE in the live shell. `StudioPanels` renders
`LayoutShell.FullPage` unconditionally, so `FullPageRouter` mounts a SECOND
TemplatesTab (and DrawerGallery) whenever `templates` is the active tab;
LayoutShell.css `display:none`s the slot, so the copy measures 0x0. It is
deliberate — the neighbouring rule says 'preserve internal state' — but it
makes measure.mjs refuse the anchor as ambiguous, and it means
`hydrateUserTemplatesFromServer()` runs twice per open.
